scope: Offline public G traces only; no training, benchmark generation or unused95 reads
rule: Reference only byte-identical successful public reads with identical full parameters in one mutation epoch. Keep first full response, all assistant plans, failures, mutations, changed versions, task/system/few-shot and latest two pairs. References preserve source/observation/turn/hash and historical status. No goal extraction or tool caching.

offline_gates.meaning: All G actor prompts, including unchanged prompts, form denominator. Calibration is separate. Exact deployed chat tokenizer, including generation prompt; offline savings do not predict online success.

online_if_offline_passes.parameters: Same model/generation/tool/step budget as frozen N33; only representation changes
online_if_offline_passes.exclusions: None for task failures; infrastructure invalidates whole affected stage, retain cost
online_if_offline_passes.statistics: seed42 paired primary; task-clustered CI for three seeds; exposed development diagnosis only

stop_rule: Freeze source manifest before analysis. One offline audit; if any gate fails, keep G and stop N34 without online GPU experiment or relaxing rules. If gates pass, commit online config before launching. No prompt rewrite or task selection after results.
cost: Record CPU wall time and tokenizer calls/time; offline has no actor/judge inference calls, no H100 reservation. A800 resident cost is not attributable here.
